dogecoin.text:
It gets interesting here:

Each card behaves like its market twin. 

If your $DOGE card gains 1% on the real charts, your Bull Run points jump 1%. 

If it dumps 2%, you're down 2%. It's a 1:1 reflection of real market price action.

Inside the Play tab...

There’s a countdown timer at the top 

This timer is for the daily card selection. 

Every 24 hours (12AM UTC), new packs drop. 

You open your pack and get cards

Each one represents a real-world crypto asset like $ETH, $DOGE, $TON, and others. https://t.co/8rAXsqM951
